objective: COA Gate 5G: reutilizar y convertir el workflow existente .github/workflows/coa-core-development-migration.yml en un canal canonico multi-migracion COA para Development, sin duplicar workflow ni helpers. Conservar compatibilidad del trigger Core existente y agregar el trigger CFDI Emitidos. Para CFDI Emitidos usar exclusivamente backend/database/migrations/20260910_coa_cfdi_emitidos.sql y backend/database/migrations/20260910_coa_cfdi_emitidos_rollback.sql certificados. El flujo debe: resolver el contrato de migracion por trigger; ejecutar preflight inmediato READ_ONLY con HRLectura; validar identidad EDARSAHUB/HRLectura y permisos CREATE TABLE + ALTER dbo antes de escribir; ejecutar migracion transaccional; ejecutar postcheck exacto; subir artifact siempre; ejecutar rollback automatico si falla la migracion o el postcheck; fallar el Gate despues de rollback; no tocar Produccion; no modificar los DDL certificados. El postcheck CFDI debe confirmar: tablas dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus y dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos existen; PK respectivas existen; 5 indices del dominio fiscal existen incluyendo UUID unique filtrado; FKs de Empresa, Unidad, Cliente, Venta, Estatus, Moneda, CreadoPor y ModificadoPor existen; COA_ExpedienteReferencias contiene VentaID bigint NULL y DocumentoFiscalEmitidoID bigint NULL; existen sus 2 FKs y sus 2 indices filtrados; CK_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_UnSoloDestino existe, esta habilitado/confiable y su definicion incluye VentaID y DocumentoFiscalEmitidoID; DocumentoFiscalID sigue referenciando Compras_DocumentosFiscales; tablas fiscales nuevas quedan en 0 filas. Crear trigger ops/migrations/requests/COA-CFDI-EMITIDOS-20260910.execute para disparar el workflow en Development. No certificar ejecucion fisica en este job: solo integrar el canal/trigger y dejar que GitHub Actions produzca run + artifact para auditoria posterior.

actions.new:
- name: Resolve canonical migration contract
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CHANGED="$(git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r "${GITHUB_SHA}")"
          if echo "${CHANGED}" | grep -qx 'ops/migrations/requests/COA-CFDI-EMITIDOS-20260910.execute'; then
            echo 'MIGRATION_KIND=CFDI_EMITIDOS' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'MIGRATION_SCRIPT=backend/database/migrations/20260910_coa_cfdi_emitidos.sql' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'ROLLBACK_SCRIPT=backend/database/migrations/20260910_coa_cfdi_emitidos_rollback.sql' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          elif echo "${CHANGED}" | grep -qx 'ops/migrations/requests/COA-CORE-20260909.execute'; then
            echo 'MIGRATION_KIND=CORE' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'MIGRATION_SCRIPT=backend/database/migrations/20260909_coa_core.sql' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
            echo 'ROLLBACK_SCRIPT=backend/database/migrations/20260909_coa_core_rollback.sql' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          else
            echo "No canonical COA migration trigger found" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Python

actions.old:
- name: Execute transactional migration
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}" 2>&1 | tee evidence/migration.txt
actions.new:
- name: Execute transactional migration
        id: migration
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          EDARSAHUB_ALLOW_MIGRATIONS: 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/backend" python backend/tools/edarsahub_sql_runner.py --mode migrate --script "${MIGRATION_SCRIPT}" 2>&1 | tee evidence/migration.txt

actions.old:
- name: Postcheck exact schema
        id: postcheck
        continue-on-error: true
actions.new:
- name: Postcheck exact schema
        id: postcheck
        if: steps.migration.outcome == 'success'
        continue-on-error: true

actions.new:
kind=os.environ['MIGRATION_KIND']
          if kind=='CORE':
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.tables WHERE name LIKE 'COA[_]%'"); tables=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.key_constraints kc JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=kc.parent_object_id WHERE kc.type='PK' AND t.name LIKE 'COA[_]%'"); pks=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.indexes i JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=i.object_id WHERE i.name LIKE 'IX_COA[_]%'"); indexes=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.tables t ON t.object_id=fk.parent_object_id WHERE t.name LIKE 'COA[_]%'"); fks=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT SUM(p.rows) n FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name LIKE 'COA[_]%'"); rows=int(cur.fetchone()['n'] or 0)
              print({'tables':tables,'pks':pks,'indexes':indexes,'fks':fks,'rows':rows})
              if tables!=7 or pks!=7 or indexes!=12 or fks!=38 or rows!=0: raise SystemExit('COA_POSTCHECK_CONTRACT_MISMATCH')
          elif kind=='CFDI_EMITIDOS':
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.tables WHERE name IN ('Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus','Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos')"); tables=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.key_constraints kc WHERE kc.type='PK' AND kc.parent_object_id IN (OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus'),OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos'))"); pks=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos') AND name IN ('UX_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_UUID','IX_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Cliente_Fecha','IX_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Empresa_Estatus','IX_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Unidad','IX_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Venta')"); fiscal_indexes=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos') AND name IN ('FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Empresa','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Unidad','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Cliente','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Venta','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Estatus','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_Moneda','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_CreadoPor','FK_Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos_ModificadoPor')"); fiscal_fks=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND ((name='VentaID' AND system_type_id=127 AND is_nullable=1) OR (name='DocumentoFiscalEmitidoID' AND system_type_id=127 AND is_nullable=1))"); coa_cols=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND name IN ('FK_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_Venta','FK_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_DocumentoFiscalEmitido')"); coa_fks=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.indexes WHERE object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND name IN ('IX_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_Venta','IX_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_DocumentoFiscalEmitido') AND has_filter=1"); coa_indexes=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT definition,is_disabled,is_not_trusted FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND name='CK_COA_ExpedienteReferencias_UnSoloDestino'"); ck=cur.fetchone()
              ck_ok=bool(ck and not ck['is_disabled'] and not ck['is_not_trusted'] and 'VentaID' in ck['definition'] and 'DocumentoFiscalEmitidoID' in ck['definition'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id WHERE fkc.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID('dbo.COA_ExpedienteReferencias') AND pc.name='DocumentoFiscalID' AND rt.name='Compras_DocumentosFiscales'"); compras_fk=int(cur.fetchone()['n'])
              cur.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.rows),0) n FROM sys.tables t JOIN sys.partitions p ON p.object_id=t.object_id AND p.index_id IN (0,1) WHERE t.name IN ('Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidosEstatus','Fiscal_DocumentosEmitidos')"); rows=int(cur.fetchone()['n'] or 0)
              print({'tables':tables,'pks':pks,'fiscal_indexes':fiscal_indexes,'fiscal_fks':fiscal_fks,'coa_cols':coa_cols,'coa_fks':coa_fks,'coa_indexes':coa_indexes,'check_ok':ck_ok,'compras_fk':compras_fk,'rows':rows})
              if not (tables==2 and pks==2 and fiscal_indexes==5 and fiscal_fks==8 and coa_cols==2 and coa_fks==2 and coa_indexes==2 and ck_ok and compras_fk==1 and rows==0): raise SystemExit('COA_CFDI_POSTCHECK_CONTRACT_MISMATCH')
          else:
              raise SystemExit('COA_UNKNOWN_MIGRATION_KIND')
          cur.close(); conn.close(); print('COA_POSTCHECK=PASS')
